text:
Aisha: alerting 11:02 UTC: spike in TLS handshake failures from eu-west-1 and ap-south-1, looks tied to keystore unwrap errors. logs attached.
Tom: copy, can you paste the error sample? :eyes:
Aisha: here:
```
2026-03-21T11:02:18Z proxy error: TLS handshake failed: peer rejected key-id 'ephemeral-v2-9a3c' reason=unknown-key-id region=eu-west-1
```
Raj: we did an RBAC prune last night. Which role was touched?
Aisha: PR removed role "keystore-operator-legacy" and added a region condition to "keystore-reader" denying unwrap outside us-east-1.
Emily: rotator logs show AccessDenied when attempting KMS unwrap starting ~10:55 UTC.
keystore-bot: rotator filtered:
```
2026-03-21T10:55:03Z ERROR rotator unwrap key=ephemeral-v2-9a3c err=KMS::AccessDenied principal=svc-rotator region=eu-west-1
```
Tom: if rotator can't unwrap, proxies retain old cert references or stale key-ids which peers no longer accept. That matches cross-region-only failures.
Raj: oh. i scoped the condition to limit blast radius but forgot rotator needs cross-region unwraps. my mistake.
Aisha: immediate mitigation options?
Emily: short list:
- revert RBAC change for the affected role (fast)
- explicitly allow rotator principal kms:Decrypt on the ephemeral keys (targeted)
- restart proxies to drop cached key-ids (cleanup)
Tom: do rollback + targeted allow. rollback first so rotator can resume automatically.
Aisha: i'm applying rollback now.
oncall-bot: Incident created SEC-2026-03-21-007 "Keystore unwrap RBAC regression causing mTLS failures" Owners: Aisha, Tom.
Aisha: rollback applied at 11:13 UTC. watching rotator.
keystore-bot: rotator:
```
2026-03-21T11:14:05Z INFO unwrap succeeded key=ephemeral-v2-9a3c principal=svc-rotator
2026-03-21T11:14:12Z INFO rotation finished for service-b proxy
```
Tom: i've restarted edge proxies in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 to purge cached cert refs.
Emily: observability follow-up: create alert for KMS::AccessDenied spikes by rotator (>3 in 5m) and tie to proxy handshake errors. Also add structured logging for key-id + principal.
Raj: i'll open a PR to change the RBAC approach: keep region condition but include explicit allow for svc-rotator and any rotator-assigned principals.
Aisha: post-incident actions:
- add integration test in CI that simulates RBAC prune and validates rotator unwraps
- add runbook snippet for KMS::AccessDenied during rotation
- ensure rotator audit logs include key-id, principal, region
Tom: runbook snippet (to add):
```
When rotator KMS::AccessDenied:
1) check recent IAM/gitops PRs for role changes
2) restore previous role or grant rotator kms:Decrypt on keys
3) monitor rotator until unwraps complete
4) restart proxies if handshake errors persist
```
Emily: scheduling the alert + runbook updates now.
Aisha: marking mitigated at 11:20 UTC after error rate normalized. proceeding to document postmortem.
Raj: sorry about the slip; will coordinate the PR with you all and add unit tests.
keystore-bot: reminder: global ephemeral-keystore garbage collection scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC. ensure rotator perms across regions before GC.
Aisha: noted. Closing thread once postmortem doc lands in security/playbooks. :thumbsup:"
